column1: # KMS2 opcodes (client exe) <-> GMS2 / Maple2 names. Names and values only; reference sources are data (not code).
# dir: recv = server->client (Maple2 SendOp.cs names; user KMS2 table primary), send = client->server (Maple2 RecvOp.cs names).
# status: confirmed (exe semantics/layout agree) | by-model (shift model or user table, exe silent) | conflict (not renamed in code).
# Shift table (kms2 -> gms2 = kms2 + shift), edges pinned from exe handlers/senders:
#   recv  0x2e..0x5f  +1   first: 0x2e Stat (35 stat types x3), 0x2f UserBattle, 0x30 UserSkinColor; GMS 0x2e FieldMutateItem absent
#                          last: 0x5d Tombstone, 0x5f UserMoveByPortal (id/pos/rot/flag, MyPC teleport); 0x56..0x5c npc/pet confirmers
#   recv  0x60..0x139 +2   first: 0x60 MassiveEvent (UIMassiveEvent dialog); GMS 0x61 ItemTitle absent
#                          high anchors: 0x10d BuddyEmote, 0x10e BuddyBadge, 0x111 BirthdayCard, 0x117 MeretUse, 0x11b Lapenshard,
#                          0x11c Prestige, 0x12b HideAndSeek, 0x12e LimitBreak; no further shift found to the top
#   recv  0x10f/0x110      conflict: user table has SyncWorld at 0x10f (+3 blip, nothing at 0x110); the model puts it at 0x110
#   send  0x38..0xaa  +1   first: 0x38 Ugc (CUgcManager); GMS 0x38 RequestApartment absent; last: 0xa9 StateReact, 0xaa TreeWatering
#   send  0xab..0xbc  +2   first: 0xab SpectateMushtopia (StateObserver); GMS 0xac Survival absent; up to 0xbc LimitBreak
#   send  (MS2Community/Maple2 kms2 branch RecvOp agrees up to 0xaa; from 0xab it runs one behind the exe: it keeps
#          GMS Survival at 0xab, but 0xab is sent by StateObserver, 0xac by UIAdventureLevelDialog, 0xb1 by the minimap
#          ping, 0xb4 by UIClosetDialog, 0xbc by UIUnlimitedEnchantDialog, ... so the exe names win there)
#   send  0xbe..0xc1       KMS-only (no Maple2 name): CheckDeleteAccount / character list / personal info agreement / home block
